summary:
plan.md is written: the twin-leg Art Deco south tower (fluted, stepped legs; four portal struts with stepped, recessed frames; an X brace under the deck; red-lit caps over the cable saddles) on a grey pier inside an elliptical fender. The deck module tiles every 16 blocks with a Warren truss, an orange railing and lamps. Both cable modules follow the given curves to half a block (slab on top), with cable bands and thin red suspender lines. It reads as the Golden Gate from the tower outline, the International Orange (terracotta), the cable curves and the suspender rows; every block id passes the check, but nothing was built or rendered. Golden Gate kit in four modules: plot 0 Art Deco south tower on pier/fender with fluted legs, four stepped portal struts, X brace, saddle caps; plot 1 tiling deck section; plots 2 and 3 catenary cables with suspenders.
All International Orange terracotta/concrete per the architect's exact tables; no interiors.

parts.name: tower massing
parts.scope: Fender ring, pier, leg stages S1..S4, tie beam, X brace, lower strut, struts 1-3 + top strut with haunches and crown, saddle caps with aircraft lights (plot 0). Helpers legStage, fenderRing, xBrace, portalStrut, saddleCap.

parts.name: tower skin
parts.scope: Fluted recessed panels by exclusion, bands, strut recessed frames and raised panels, ledge slabs, lamp panels. Helpers fluteFace, bandCourse.

parts.name: deck
parts.scope: Plot 1 deck section (z 0..15, tiling) and the deck through plot 0 with walkways. Helpers deckSection, walkway.

parts.name: cables
parts.scope: Plot 2 and plot 3 main/side-span cables with slabs, bands and suspenders. Helpers cableCell, suspender.

parts.name: lights and trim
parts.scope: Deck lamps, pier/fender lanterns, walkway lamps, spawn check. Helpers deckLamp, lanternAt.

recruit.why: Solid stepped tower legs, fluting by exclusion, struts and bracing
Warren truss, tiling seamless deck section and walkways
Lamps and lanterns so no mob spawns
